title: No Mind No Heroes
description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring a giant dripping eyeball with a green iris in the night sky, a bandaged mummy labeled 'NO MIND' standing on a stone bridge, and a purple masked figure with another dripping eye. The foreground contains vibrant purple and pink flowers with faces, a skeletal hand, and a sign reading 'NO MORE HEROES'. A green dragon and a horned silhouette appear in the cosmic background filled with planets and aurora.
